summary: Implemented a bounded, evidence-based live telemetry WebSocket lifecycle so transport open is not presented as live, reconnect remains bounded and timer-safe, terminal auth/configuration states remain distinct, and stale snapshots remain visible without live presentation.
scope_completed: created Issue #199 feature branch and focused draft PR #214 from current main
verified current main before using historical PR #175 as reference only
added a separate bounded WebSocket connection-open timeout
kept all client-originated close codes in the browser-valid private range 4000-4999
required authenticated acknowledgement, heartbeat or valid sample before connected state
reset reconnect backoff only after valid live evidence
centralized cleanup for connection, authentication, heartbeat and reconnect timers
preserved fresh credential resolution for every reconnect
preserved resume cursor and event-id deduplication
preserved distinct unauthorized, forbidden and configuration terminal states
added five focused WebSocket lifecycle tests
added three dashboard stale/offline presentation tests
updated two legacy assertions that incorrectly treated transport open as live
removed all temporary formatter and test-update workflows from the product diff
updated CURRENT_STATE, ACTIVE_SPRINT, BLOCKERS and LAST_CHECKPOINT
